findings.title: How close Locksmith gets to the final margin
findings.text: Locksmith misses the final margin by 12.59 points on average; the closing spread misses by 12.28, the opening spread by 12.35 (Locksmith on the same games: 12.55).

findings.title: Does the market move toward Locksmith?
findings.text: When Locksmith disagreed with the opener by 3+ points, the line moved its way before kickoff 55% of the time (correlation 0.25, 8,487 games). That is the sign of real information the opener had not priced yet.

findings.title: Spread at the opening line (cover model)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 76-65 (+2.9%, +4.1 units). The same bets at the closing line: -11.9%. They beat the closing number 75% of the time.

findings.title: Total at the opening line (cover model)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 2001-1601 (+6.0%, +218.1 units). The same bets at the closing line: +1.8%. They beat the closing number 56% of the time.

findings.title: Spread at the opening line (raw gap)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 651-570 (+1.8%, +21.8 units). The same bets at the closing line: -4.5%. They beat the closing number 57% of the time.

findings.title: Total at the opening line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 2355-1960 (+4.2%, +180.9 units). The same bets at the closing line: +0.3%. They beat the closing number 52% of the time.

findings.title: Windy-game unders at the opener
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 712-574 (+5.6%, +73.3 units). The same bets at the closing line: +0.3%. They beat the closing number 60% of the time.

findings.title: Spread at the closing line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 367-340 (-0.9%, -6.4 units).

findings.title: Total at the closing line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 223-236 (-7.2%, -33.3 units).

findings.title: Windy-game unders at the close
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 445-391 (+1.6%, +13.5 units).
